name: context-graph
description: Persists file summaries, code implementation relationships, queried data, and generated insights in a local SQLite knowledge graph so Antigravity can understand the codebase without burning tokens re-reading files.
suggestedPrompts: Index this workspace into the context graph and show the module relationship map
Search the context cache for previously queried data and implementation relationships
Check which cached files are stale and refresh only the modified files
